input: Find a squash court and book a beginner session

gold.taskTitle: Find and Book a Beginner Squash Court Session
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to locate a suitable squash court nearby and reserve a beginner-level playing session.

questions.title: What city or neighbourhood should the court be in?
questions.description: Identify the user's preferred location or proximity to home, work, or another landmark.

questions.title: What date do you want to play?
questions.description: Pin down the target date so availability can be checked accurately.

questions.title: What time of day works best for you?
questions.description: Determine whether the user prefers morning, afternoon, or evening slots.

questions.title: Will you be playing alone or with someone?
questions.description: Clarify whether a solo coaching session, a partner session, or a group class is needed.

questions.title: Do you need coaching included in the session?
questions.description: Establish whether a beginner instructor or coach should be part of the booking.

questions.title: What is your maximum budget for this session?
questions.description: Understand the price range the user is comfortable with for court hire and any coaching fees.

questions.title: Do you have a membership at any sports centre already?
questions.description: Check whether the user has existing memberships that could reduce cost or limit venue options.
